name: Soft Shoulders
description: A slow, quiet rest where you notice each part of yourself and let it be. About five minutes.

cues.text: Find a comfortable way to sit or lie.
Notice your feet. They have carried you all day.
Notice your legs, and let them be heavy and still.
Notice your hands. Let them open, just a little.
Notice your shoulders. If they have crept upward, let them settle.
Notice your face. Let your jaw and brow go soft.
Rest here a moment longer. There is nothing to do.
